name: Beastlord
description: A primal warrior who tames ferocious beasts and fights alongside them, blending melee prowess with animal cunning.
lore: Born in the untamed Wyldlands, Beastlords form unbreakable bonds with the creatures most adventurers would flee from. Their companion beasts are not mere pets — they are brothers and sisters in battle.

abilities.name: Feral Strike
abilities.description: A savage strike that deals physical damage to a single enemy.

abilities.name: Call Wolf
abilities.description: Calls a dire wolf companion to fight alongside the party for 5 turns.

abilities.name: Wild Roar
abilities.description: Lets out a primal roar that increases all allies' Physical ATK by 15% for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.description: Coordinates with beast companions, increasing Physical ATK by 25% and Crit Rate by 10% for self and all summons for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Summon Bear
abilities.description: Summons a great bear that taunts enemies on arrival and absorbs damage for the party for 5 turns.

abilities.name: Nature Rend
abilities.description: Tears into the enemy for 1.6x physical damage plus a nature bleed over 3 turns. Deals 50% bonus damage if a beast companion is active.

abilities.name: Bond of the Wild
abilities.description: Passive: Beast companions gain 20% more HP. While a companion is active, the Beastlord gains 10% Dodge and 10% Poison Resistance.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.description: Ultimate: Unleashes a stampede of all beast companions, dealing 2x physical damage to all enemies with a 40% chance to stun for 1 turn.

synergies: Auramancer: Aura buffs affect beast companions too, making the pack devastatingly strong
Rogue: Pack Tactics crit bonus pairs well with the Rogue's high crit damage
Warrior: Bear summon and Warrior taunt together create an impenetrable front line
weaknesses: Split stats mean neither melee nor pet damage excels alone early on
Heavily reliant on having beast companions active for full effectiveness
Low INT and WIS make magical enemies difficult to deal with
AoE attacks from enemies quickly destroy beast companions
hire_description: A weathered ranger sits cross-legged by the hearth, a massive wolf dozing at their feet. As you approach, the wolf opens one eye. The ranger smiles. "Don't worry, she only bites things I tell her to. Usually."
